[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 21:58  
[EVENT] User is thinking of cleaning their jewelry collection this weekend.  
[EVENT] User recently got a new pair of emerald earrings at a flea market last weekend.  
[PREFERENCE] User is absolutely loving their new emerald earrings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on your new emerald earrings!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General tips for cleaning jewelry include handling with care, avoiding harsh chemicals, using a soft cloth, and drying thoroughly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For gold and silver jewelry, mix a solution of warm water and mild soap, soak for 15-30 minutes, scrub gently with a soft-bristled toothbrush, rinse, and dry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For pearls, gently wipe with a soft, damp cloth and avoid soap or harsh chemicals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For diamonds and gemstones, use a mild soap solution, soak for 15-30 minutes, scrub gently, rinse, and dry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For tarnished silver jewelry, use a silver polishing cloth or a baking soda solution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For costume jewelry, gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth and avoid harsh chemicals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ultrasonic cleaners can be used but should be avoided with pearls, opals, or emeralds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Professional cleaning is recommended if unsure about cleaning a piece.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To store emerald earrings, store them separately in a soft, padded pouch or individual compartments to prevent scratching.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Invest in a high-quality jewelry box or case with individual compartments to keep emerald earrings organized and protected.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Store emerald earrings away from direct sunlight and in a dry, well-ventilated area.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid storing emerald earrings in a pile to prevent scratching or damage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regularly check on stored emerald earrings to ensure they are not developing damage.  
[EVENT] User is planning to take inventory of their jewelry collection and take photos of each piece.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for taking good photos of jewelry include using natural light, a macro lens, a plain background, and focusing on details.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid using flash and consider using a tripod for stability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use a mild soap solution for cleaning emerald earrings and avoid harsh chemicals.
